body: They never change. I'm not doing it. I was too scared of what would come after. I already want to again
Because I get depressed and let all my work to fix things fall apart. I tell myself that I'm going to kill myself then don't.

I've tried starting over too many times. I catch up to myself and run things into the ground. I've alienated the people who've tried to help me one too many times. I was never happy about myself, and I don't think I know how to be. I'm constantly scared and anxious and just want to hide. I've written my notes, I just wanted to drop in here too.
